title: Rav Dimi bar Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Sanhedrin 24a according to the readings of Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin; his “our version” reads Rav Dimi son of Rav Nachman.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Sanhedrin 24a paragraph reads Rav Dimi son of Rav Nachman son of Rav Yosef. Hyman’s Nechemyah heading, his Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin reports, and his shorter ‘our version’ wording remain literal and distinct. Neither named work was freshly collated, and the digital chain is not substituted into Hyman’s text or bound as a genealogy.
